AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
August 15, 2012
7:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

1.
Use Permit UP 2012-03 Location: 457 E. Arrow Highway, # F & #G, Azusa, CA 91702
Applicant: Dr. Jang Woo Kim, Azusa Animal Hospital
Assessor Parcel Numbers: 8621-008-052
Request for approval of a modification to an existing Conditional Use Permit C-90-14 which allowed an animal hospital at 457 E. Arrow Highway, #G in the CAH zone. The modification (UP 2012-03) is to allow the expansion of the existing animal hospital into the adjacent tenant space.
Item F-1 Staff Report & Attachments
2.
Use Permit UP 2012-02 Applicant: Mr. & Mrs. Piper/Lindley Scott House
Location: 710 - 720 E. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, CA 91702
APN: 8624-002-057
A request for approval of Use Permit No. 2012-02 to modify an existing Conditional Use Permit (CUP-2000-08) to upgrade the existing beer and wine license (type 41) to a full liquor license (type 47), and to permit extended hours of operation for the Lindley Scott House banquet facility. The proposed hours of operation are 10 a.m. - 11 p.m., Monday thru Thursday and 10 a.m. thru 12 a.m., Friday thru Sunday.
Item F-2 Staff Report & Attachments
3.
Design Review DR 2012-01 & Minor Use Permit MUP 2012-02 Applicant: City of Azusa
Location: 213 E. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, CA 91702
A request for a Design Review and Minor Use Permit to allow the construction and use of an Intermodal Parking Facility and the review of the associated Environmental Impact Report.
Item F-3 Staff Report
